title: 说好中文很酷：东南亚华裔青年正在重塑一门传承语言
subtitle: 从马来西亚留学生萧国庆的「说好中文很酷」，看离散青年如何把一门「祖辈义务」重新定义为「文化资本」
summary: 马来西亚华裔青年萧国庆一句「说好中文，是一件很酷的事情」，折射出东南亚华人社区一场静水流深的身份转向。本文认为，真正的变化不在于年轻一代「会说中文」，而在于他们「如何看待说中文」：流利中文正从「祖辈传下来的义务」被重新定义为文化资本——接入世界第二大经济体的通行证、行走中国的能力、内容创作的工具。三股力量合力推动：中国经济体量抬升使中文由「情怀」变「技能」；「留学中国」与「China Travel」热潮把原乡变成实地；社交媒体让离散创作者绕开中介、直接面向跨国华语受众。但这一「酷」的重构也是双刃剑：它赋权青年，却也将他们重新推回地缘政治的放大镜下。一门传承之语得以延续，终究靠每一代人自己认定它「值得说」，有时更靠认定它「很酷」。
imageAlt: 吉隆坡街头，行人穿梭于都市街区，象征东南亚华裔青年的都市日常。

en.title: "Speaking Chinese Is Cool": How Southeast Asia's Ethnic Chinese Youth Are Rebranding a Heritage Language
en.subtitle: From a Malaysian student's "speaking Chinese is cool" to a generational reframing of a heritage tongue as cultural capital
en.summary: A young Malaysian, Xiao Guoqing, summed up his pride in one line: "Speaking good Chinese is a cool thing." Behind that sentence lies a quiet shift in Southeast Asia's ethnic Chinese communities. This piece argues the change is not that the young speak Chinese, but how they value it: fluent Mandarin is being redefined from an inherited obligation into cultural capital — a pass into the world's second-largest economy, a capacity to move through China, a tool for content creation. Three forces converge: China's economic weight turns Chinese from sentiment into skill; the "Study in China" and "China Travel" booms make the ancestral homeland tangible; and social media lets diaspora creators bypass gatekeepers to address a transnational Chinese-speaking audience. Yet this "cool" reframing is double-edged: it empowers the young, but also slides them back under the geopolitical microscope. A heritage tongue survives not because governments protect it, but because each generation decides it is worth speaking — and, sometimes, that it is cool.
en.imageAlt: A Kuala Lumpur street scene — pedestrians moving through the urban fabric of Southeast Asian youth's daily life.

title: 原子进场，比特出局：峇淡岛的工厂与马尼拉的工位
subtitle: 关税战把实体制造推进东南亚，生成式AI却在抽走这里的白领岗位——同一场外部冲击，两个相反方向
country: 印度尼西亚 / 菲律宾
summary: 同一周，印尼峇淡岛因美国关税战崛起为代工转移基地（去年增速6.8%，高于全国5.1%），菲律宾外包业员工却在训练AI后被裁。本文认为两者并非无关：关税把实体生产推进东南亚，AI把认知型工作抽离东南亚，委托方却是同一批欧美企业。三重不对称尤其关键——工厂搬迁可逆而AI替代不可逆；数据中心资本密集而外包业以190万岗位养活中产；GDP算术可以好看，造就中产的引擎却可能同时熄火。
imageAlt: 厂房内的产业工人，东南亚代工制造业的日常场景。

en.title: Atoms In, Bits Out: Batam's Factories, Manila's Desks, and Southeast Asia's Two-Front Reordering
en.subtitle: The tariff war is pushing physical production into the region while generative AI pulls cognitive work out of it — one external shock, two opposite directions
en.summary: In a single news cycle, Indonesia's Batam emerged as a tariff-driven relocation hub for contract manufacturing while Philippine outsourcing workers were dismissed after training the AI that replaced them. This piece argues the two are one ledger: the same Western cost decisions push atoms into the region and pull bits out of it. Three asymmetries matter — relocation is reversible while automation is not; data centres are capital-intensive while BPO sustained 1.9 million jobs; and the specific engine that built a Filipino middle class has no equivalent in what is arriving.
en.imageAlt: Industrial workers on a factory floor — a familiar scene in Southeast Asia's contract-manufacturing economy.

en.title: When the Screen Spoke Teochew: A Film and the Slow Thaw of Indonesia's Chinese Memory
en.subtitle: From the Jakarta premiere of 'A Letter to Amah' to a diaspora memory suppressed by structural silence and reconnected through culture
en.summary: On 5 August 2026, the documentary 'A Letter to Amah' premiered in Jakarta. An eighty-two-year-old woman recognized her own father's southward migration in the film's protagonist. This piece reads the moment as a window into how Indonesia's ethnic Chinese memory was structurally silenced for three decades by the ban on Chinese languages and schools, and how it is now being reconnected through film, family letters, and qiaoxiang ties.

en.title: Crossing the "Friendly" Threshold: China-Indonesia Relations Under Prabowo at a Historic High
en.subtitle: Behind the trajectory from 5.9 to 6.2 — economic gravity, institutional upgrading, and South China Sea undercurrents
en.summary: Based on Tsinghua University's Institute of International Relations score table, China's Relations with Major Powers (1950–August 2025), bilateral relations rose from 5.9 to 6.2 under Prabowo, crossing into the "friendly" band at a historic high.
